question: which hash should measure artifact bytes when a proof must bind them

designs.poseidon_direct: absorb every byte into the algebraic sponge; the proof binds the bytes
designs.blake3_only: not a scheme, the floor: the cost of reading the bytes once
designs.hybrid: BLAKE3 to 32 bytes, absorb only the digest; the proof binds the digest

security_note: the hybrid rests on BLAKE3 collision resistance, which this crate's proof context already assumes, so it removes redundant work rather than adding an assumption
